name: LODA
description: LODA projects each input vector onto k sparse random 1-D directions. It builds a one-dimensional histogram on each projection, so each histogram is a density estimate. A point’s anomaly score is the average negative log-likelihood across all k histograms. Points that fall into low-density bins on many projections get high scores.
